independent_audit.scope: Independent CPU receipts and complete output arithmetic; no network recomputation.

interpretation: Declared weight8 trial fails primary gate. No promotion; continuation remains experimental. First-target training fit improves while held-out first CE worsens in all seeds. Training wall time is observational, not an isolated performance benchmark.
limitations: No checkpoint deserialization or inference; checkpoint bytes and sidecars are bound to CLI receipts.
Seeds share validation queries and CUDA training is nondeterministic.
Ordered first choice and true-set membership are different diagnostics; neither replaces the full-generation gate.
Gate eligibility is not oracle parity, protected-test use or serving promotion.
scope: Continuation1/first8 trial; validation only; graph labels diagnostic only
